comment: Synthetic test data for gr0wthlab's Weekly Read checks, in the shape of a real creative log; it is not any Product's package. One record per Angle of the synthetic Angle bank.

angles.verbatim_quote: just tell me what to do
angles.hypothesis: A session already on screen holds viewers
angles.hook: Open it and the session is already waiting.
angles.ab_pair: AB-1 (leg A; leg B hook: 'The session is on screen before you decide.')
angles.preregistered_success_signal: Watched-full rate in the top half
angles.kill_criterion: Bottom quartile watched-full on two reads

angles.verbatim_quote: one missed day and I was back to zero
angles.hypothesis: A founder story beats a mechanic demo
angles.hook: I missed five days and the app welcomed me back.
angles.preregistered_success_signal: On-topic comments in the top half
angles.kill_criterion: No on-topic comments after two reads

angles.hypothesis: A silent score demo is believed
angles.hook: Skip a day and the score dips. It never resets.
angles.ab_pair: AB-2 (leg A; leg B hook: 'A skipped day never takes you back to zero.')
angles.preregistered_success_signal: Viewed rate in the top half
angles.kill_criterion: Bottom quartile viewed rate on two reads

angles.verbatim_quote: it needs a connection to start
angles.hook: Airplane mode on. The session still appears.
angles.kill_criterion: No offline comments after two reads

angles.verbatim_quote: the app takes forever to load
angles.hypothesis: The under-100ms build reads as credible
angles.hook: The session builds before the screen settles.
angles.preregistered_success_signal: Average viewed in the top half
angles.kill_criterion: Bottom quartile viewed on two reads

angles.verbatim_quote: I have no room for equipment
angles.hook: A hallway is enough room for today.
angles.format: 12s pan of a hallway, then the app
angles.kill_criterion: Bottom quartile saves on two reads

angles.hypothesis: Five minutes framed as showing up
angles.hook: Five minutes still counts as showing up.
angles.kill_criterion: Bottom quartile saves on two reads
